title: Proposal: working together on Niemann-Pick disease type C research

sentences.text: A proposal to work together on research into Niemann-Pick disease type C.
We are writing to Niemann-Pick UK because you support families affected by Niemann-Pick diseases, including type C.
We have not met yet, and we would value your guidance.
NPC1-related disease is linked to loss of function and to lysosomal storage of lipids.
The International Niemann-Pick Disease Registry and the SOAR research network include people with the condition.
A phase 3 study of N-acetyl-L-leucine is recruiting, and studies of arimoclomol and miglustat have completed.
A contested point: misfolding is described for the most frequent variant, but the arimoclomol label states that its mechanism in this disease is unknown.
We would propose a study on [research question about Niemann-Pick disease type C], shaped with your community from the start.
Its design, sites and funding are still to be settled: [study details].

sections.heading: What we would ask of you

sentences.text: Would you be open to discussing this idea with us?
If so, we would like to learn how the International Niemann-Pick Disease Registry or your community might take part, always with proper consent and ethics approval.
We are not asking for any personal information about patients or families.
If this is of interest, could we arrange a short call at a time that suits you?
